top_signals.title: Gold Edges Lower Ahead of Warsh Speech That Could Shape Fed Bets

top_signals.title: Indian Software Stocks Set to Beat AI Peers by Most in Decades
top_signals.summary: India’s information-technology stocks are poised to beat their global semiconductor rivals by the most in two decades this week, with analysts saying the sector is set to keep outperforming as the artificial-intelligence rally unwinds.
